key_points: Q4 EPS guidance missed by 12%, triggering a 5.8-7% selloff and unwinding a recent rally to record highs.
Apple's modem shift is a structural headwind eroding QCOM's core handset chipset revenue base.
MediaTek's 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro intensifies competitive pressure on Qualcomm's premium Android position.
Automotive at record $1.6B and AI data center partnerships (Lumentum, Corning, Amazon) provide partial offset but are not yet large enough to counter handset weakness.
Upcoming Snapdragon Summit could provide a short-term catalyst, but negative estimate revisions and guidance miss dominate near-term sentiment.
